checks.name: Native motion survives interpolation and velocity/shape edits while intentional transforms, teleport and origin shift remain authoritative

scope: Fresh production starter generation, actual project parser/migration/serializer and GameplayRuntime with compiled WASM physics+Rhai. Public InputManager handlers receive controlled keyboard events; game UI uses a Canvas command recorder, audio uses an observable media host, saves use isolated storage. No browser pixel/device, physical sound or full user-click E2E qualification.
deferred: Starters do not cover every collision shape/joint, atlas rendering edge, controller transition, normal map or audio device. These are specialist retained regression scopes.
Responsive UI button/checkbox events are functional; a complete menu-to-game behavior, theme assignment and click-sound binding are demonstration-authoring gaps, not missing engine primitives.
